snippet.title: Samurai Shodown / Spirits (Super Nintendo/SNES) (Long) Japanese Commercial
snippet.description:
Haohmaru and Jubei duel in this somewhat goofy, but highly entertaining commercial for the fighter that really put SNK on the map. Slice into a translation for the Super Famicom packaging translation: https://chrisaaronblog.blogspot.com/2024/07/samurai-shodown-samurai-spirits-super.html

- Check out my *original videos* (Game Reviews 🎮, Book/Manga Reviews 📚, Piano Playing 🎹 and more) at https://www.youtube.com/@83chrisaaronextra

- *Visit my blog* at https://chrisaaronblog.blogspot.com/ or http://www.chrislovesjapan.com where I'm on a quest to catalog and translate every Japanese retro video game 🎮 package. Japanese lessons, as well as other original content is also posted regularly.

Raw video taken from the "wadelyjp" channel.

My transcription of the audio:
弧月斬！
斬り捨て御免の剣術アクション。
スーパーファミコン。サムライスピリッツ
